data.body: AC amendment (gap finding 3): UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP downstream contract. The escape records the signal as a ticket comment on the epic, then terminates Phase 1 (does NOT proceed to Phase 2 or hand off to preplanning). It is a user-visible signal: after recording the comment, inform the user that no further gap questions can be generated without repetition, and that Phase 1 has ended without a full gap resolution. The user must re-invoke /dso:brainstorm or manually confirm intent to proceed. Add to AC: SKILL.md text must specify that UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP terminates Phase 1 (not proceeds to Phase 2) and that the user is informed. Verify: grep -qiE 'terminate.*Phase 1|terminat.*instead.*loop' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
